pages.text: An airtight radiator. Dumps excess heat without losing oxygen or using fuel.

pages.title: Automatic
pages.text: A $(l:heating/thermostat)Thermostat$(/l) in the same room opens it above target and closes it at target.$(br2)More vents cool faster, but never past the target.

pages.name: Heat Vent in a Wall
pages.text: Room on the floor side. Fins face out; keep the block in front of them clear.

pages.title: Placement
pages.text: Place it facing outdoors: fins away from you, back touching the room.$(br2)Keep $(bold)one block$() in front of the fins clear. Cave roofs and overhead glass are fine; a block or water there stops it.

pages.title: Manual Use
pages.text: Without a thermostat, right-click toggles the shutter and redstone holds it open.$(br2)$(danger)An open vent wastes heater fuel.$()

pages.title: Lights
pages.text: Grille: $(bold)dim$() closed, $(bold)green$() venting, $(bold)amber$() waiting or blocked.$(br2)The fins glow orange while heat is actually leaving. Updates each second.

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: Heat only flows to a colder outside, and a warm exterior cuts its output.$(br2)It cools the air first while the walls keep warming it.

pages.title: Specs

Six iron, two copper and a lever. A full wall or roof block.
